title: Volunteering at an Animal Shelter
title_zh: 在动物收容所做志愿者
context: 新志愿者 Hana 向动物收容所工作人员 Luis 了解当天的任务和指导安排。 本课为 2026-11-22 预制系列原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: This is my first day volunteering here. Where should I start?
dialogue.zh: 这是我第一天在这里做志愿者。我应该从哪里开始？

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: Welcome, Hana. Today we need help folding clean towels for the cats.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎你，Hana。今天我们需要人帮猫咪叠干净的毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I can do that. Where should I put them?
dialogue.zh: 我可以做。叠好放在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: Please stack them on the shelves in the supply room.
dialogue.zh: 请把它们叠放在储物间的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I would also love to spend time with the animals.
dialogue.zh: 我也很想和动物们待一会儿。

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: After the towels, I can introduce you to a calm cat named Pepper.
dialogue.zh: 叠完毛巾后，我可以介绍你认识一只叫 Pepper 的温顺猫咪。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: That sounds lovely. Is there anything I should know first?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我需要先了解什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: I will show you how our staff approach her and stay with you.
dialogue.zh: 我会示范我们工作人员怎样接近她，并陪着你。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: Thank you. I do not want to make her nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: That is thoughtful. We let each animal set the pace.
dialogue.zh: 你想得很周到。我们让每只动物按自己的节奏来。

dialogue.speaker: Hana
dialogue.en: I will start with the towels while you finish your work.
dialogue.zh: 那我先叠毛巾，你继续忙。

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.en: Great. I will meet you in the supply room shortly.
dialogue.zh: 好。我一会儿到储物间找你。

expressions.example: I volunteer at a local food pantry.
The extra paper is in the supply room.
She likes to spend time with her grandparents.
A loud noise can make the dog nervous.
Let the beginner set the pace of the walk.

pronunciation: volunteer 重音在最后一个音节；shelter 重音在第一音节，结尾的 r 用美式卷舌音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Helping
practice.prompt: Have you ever helped an organization in your community?
practice.answer: Yes. I helped a local shelter sort clean towels. It was a small task, but it gave the staff more time for other work.

practice.title: Part 2 · A volunteer experience
practice.prompt: Describe a volunteer activity you would like to try. Say where you would go, what you would do, and why.
practice.answer: I would like to volunteer at an animal shelter near my home. On my first visit, I could help fold clean towels and organize supplies. I would also ask a staff member to show me how to spend time with a calm cat. I would follow their guidance and let the animal move at its own pace. I think the work would be useful and rewarding. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Volunteering
practice.prompt: Why do organizations need volunteers for both simple and skilled tasks?
practice.answer: Simple tasks still take time, so volunteers can help staff focus on work that needs special training. Clear guidance also helps everyone understand their role.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读第一天询问任务的对话，再说明你愿意做什么以及需要什么指导。
practice.answer: Where should I start? I can fold the clean towels. Could you show me where to put them?
